limits: Explicit versioned receipt paths only; a future cohort or thermal review requires a new manifest, not trusted directory discovery.
The original finite-pipeline stopped_no_retry record is preserved. Supplemental invocation completion never implies scientific success.
Only the ordered quantile producer may replace its original producer; every other argv, output, source and condition must match the original plan.
Logs have no original producer digest; their bytes are pinned at audit time alongside completed, attempt and result receipts and rechecked before return.

Every child binds its full freshly qualified parent, sources and recursive cache/input hashes. Qualified histories at declared accuracy are separate from plotting-safe histories with supported finite native precision.

A thermal review is accepted only through freshly replayed native_precision_review_consumer.verify; original flags remain visible, genuine variation/failures block native-accuracy-supported plots and lensing.
A supported32point numerical screen is a limited diagnostic, not a new posterior qualification, convergence proof or precision guarantee across the entire posterior.

precision_review_schema.verified_receipt_sha256: required if receipt path is supplied

validation: Synthetic qualified/failed/pending receipts, exact allowed substitution, repeated receipt/output refusal, changed argv/source/output, wrong parent/target, missing receipt/log, and repaired-versus-genuine precision decisions; no physical calls.
